QuestInfo.name: [Karote] The Third Statue
QuestInfo.0:
You reached the top of the tower.
Anything could happen here, from triumph to catastrophe.
If you're ready, approach the #bstatue#k.
QuestInfo.1: The #bstatue#k has transported you to another new location. The enemies here are the strongest you've encountered on this expedition. For now, do what you can to defeat them.
QuestInfo.2: The automatons here seem to recognize you as a #r'vessel of the Adversary'#k, as does the figure from the memories...
